newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas rises as each month trades, Mar busiest.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas rises as each month trades, Mar busiest.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures moved sharply upwards on Wednesday afternoon, with front month March adding a penny, or 11 percent, from its Tuesday settlement price of 9.00 pence to close at 10.00 pence a therm.
Every other month was traded, and all moved upwards, though none so strongly as March.

"The contract expires tomorrow, there are a lot of short positions and this was to be anticipated," a broker said. "There's great support at 9.00 pence. I don't think it'll trade below 9.00 pence now and it could go up to 10.50 or 11.00 pence before the close."
A total of 435 lots were traded, including 130 in March, and there was good depth to both bids and offers for many periods.
The March contract will be traded on both the morning and afternoon sessions on Thursday.

Several brokers have said they expect to see keen interest in the last period before expiry. Many are thought to have gone short on March with a view to buying relatively cheap supplies on the futures market for physical delivery rather than buying at higher prices earlier in the winter.
